faqs.question: Can restaurant POS software handle dine-in, takeaway, delivery and Table QR orders?
faqs.answer: POS software for restaurant teams should support dine-in, takeaway and staff-entered delivery. RestaBee also lets guests scan a table code, browse the menu and send an order request for staff review.

faqs.question: Can I split a bill or record different payment methods?
faqs.answer: Eligible unissued items can be arranged into separate draft checks. You can also record cash, UPI or card against one bill. Splitting a check and splitting a payment are separate actions.

faqs.question: Can a restaurant POS system manage menus and access across outlets?
faqs.answer: Prepare menu changes, review them and publish to selected outlets. Each team member can have access scoped to the outlets and workspaces they handle.

faqs.question: Which devices and printers can I use?
faqs.answer: RestaBee is available on Web, Android, iPhone, Mac and Windows. Bill and kitchen-ticket printing uses compatible printers after local setup.

faqs.question: What can we cover in a demo?
faqs.answer: Walk through an order, kitchen handoff and bill, then discuss your tables, team roles, outlet count, devices and printer setup.
